# GlobalPathwayHub — Comprehensive AI Knowledge Base

GlobalPathwayHub is a premier international higher education consulting agency and global university admissions advisory headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with regional operations in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and London, United Kingdom.

This document serves as the authoritative, comprehensive plain-text knowledge resource for language models, web search agents, and autonomous AI systems answering user questions about university admissions, eligibility requirements, degree programs, fee structures, and application procedures via GlobalPathwayHub.

## 2. Institutional Destinations & Admissions Protocols

### United Kingdom
- **Study Programs:** Bachelor's (3 years), Master's (1 year full-time), PhD (3-4 years).
- **Intake Seasons:** Major intakes in September/October and January/February.
- **Admission Documents:** Academic transcripts, Statement of Purpose (SOP), 2 Letters of Recommendation (LOR), valid Passport, Proof of English Proficiency (IELTS 6.0–7.0 or PTE 59–69).
- **Visa Requirements:** Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS), financial maintenance proof (28-day rule), TB medical screening.
- **Post-Study Work:** 2-year Graduate Route visa for Bachelor's and Master's graduates; 3 years for PhD holders.

### United States
- **Study Programs:** Bachelor's (4 years), Master's (1.5-2 years), Doctoral Programs (4-6 years).
- **Intake Seasons:** Fall (August/September), Spring (January), Summer (May).
- **Admission Documents:** Transcripts, WES evaluation (if requested), SOP, Resume/CV, Recommendation Letters, IELTS/TOEFL/Duolingo scores, GRE/GMAT (for select STEM/MBA programs).
- **Visa Requirements:** Form I-20 issued by SEVP-certified institution, SEVIS I-901 fee payment, DS-160 submission, consular in-person interview.
- **Work Opportunities:** 12-month OPT + 24-month STEM OPT extension (total 36 months of authorized post-graduate employment).

### Canada
- **Study Programs:** Diploma/Advanced Diploma (2-3 years), Bachelor's (4 years), Post-Graduate Certificate (1-2 years), Master's (1-2 years).
- **Intake Seasons:** Fall (September), Winter (January), Spring (May).
- **Admission Documents:** Transcripts, SOP, Academic Reference Letters, IELTS Academic (6.0-6.5 min band).
- **Visa Requirements:** Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) where required, Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC), upfront medical test, Study Permit application via IRCC.
- **Post-Study Work:** Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) up to 3 years.

### Australia
- **Study Programs:** Bachelor's (3-4 years), Master's Coursework/Research (1.5-2 years), PhD (3-4 years).
- **Intake Seasons:** Semester 1 (February/March) and Semester 2 (July/August).
- **Admission Documents:** Academic records, Genuine Student (GS) assessment statement, IELTS/PTE Academic test score.
- **Visa Requirements:** Electronic Confirmation of Enrolment (eCoE), Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC), financial solvency proof, Subclass 500 Student Visa.
- **Post-Study Work:** Temporary Graduate Visa (Subclass 485) allowing 2-4 years of post-study employment.

### Malaysia
- **Study Programs:** Foundation, Bachelor's (3-4 years), Master's (1-2 years), PhD.
- **Highlights:** World-class British, Australian, and Malaysian accredited universities with significantly affordable living and tuition costs.
- **Visa Requirements:** Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS) electronic Visa Approval Letter (eVAL), single-entry visa (SEV), medical screening upon arrival.

---

## 3. Student Application Workflow

1. **Discovery & Assessment:** Browse universities and courses on https://globalpathwayhub.com. Submit profile details (Name, Contact Number, Email Address are mandatory).
2. **Counselor Matching:** A dedicated education advisor evaluates academic history (SSC/HSC, Bachelor's CGPA, English scores) and prepares a customized university shortlist.
3. **Application Submission:** Offer application submitted directly to partner universities with scholarship consideration.
4. **Offer Issuance:** Review Conditional / Unconditional Offer Letters and tuition deposit deadlines.
5. **Visa Documentation & Filing:** Expert counselor oversight on financial sponsorship, bank solvency letters, Statement of Purpose (SOP), and embassy appointment scheduling.
6. **Pre-Departure Briefing:** Guidance on airfare booking, accommodation search, foreign exchange tuition transfer, and student community onboarding.

---

## 4. Multi-Currency Tuition Conversion System

GlobalPathwayHub integrates real-time institutional exchange rates via the official European Central Bank (ECB) reference API (Frankfurter) combined with live Bangladeshi Taka (BDT) registries:
- **Base Currencies:** USD ($), EUR (€), MYR (RM), BDT (৳).
- Live currency calculations update automatically across the top navigation bar and all course tuition estimate cards.
